event.description: Project eleven fixed Fourier and parity position features into the residual stream
event.proposal: Family: position representation. Current retained frontier is 1,672 parameters at 99.010000%, a +0.010000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 6 prior attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0030, which removed the never-forwarded positional row and qualified at 2,128 parameters and 99.14%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0108, whose rank-3 learned positional factorization scored 0.00% at 1,634 parameters. Hypothesis: attempt-0108 failed because unconstrained low-rank codes erased smooth order and operand-pair parity, whereas addition positions can be represented by fixed multiscale phase plus parity features. This major positional substitution replaces 182 grouped scalars with eleven deterministic features (constant, linear phase, four sine/cosine pairs, parity) and one learned 11x16 projection fitted by least squares, yielding 1,666 parameters. It is more informative than a smaller Fourier basis because eleven is the largest feature count that remains strictly below the current position parameterization and therefore minimizes projection loss while directly encoding column alternation. Token streams, attention, autoregressive logits, and generic decoding remain unchanged.
